title: Abstract states the representation's share as established fact and splits the gap 50/50, dropping the optimiser caveat the rest of the paper carries
why_wrong: Two separate overstatements in one sentence, both of which the paper elsewhere explicitly forbids. Say 'at most', never 'is'." The Discussion complies (main.tex:1899-1901: "the residual twofold is the representation and the optimiser together, and the representation's own share is at most that and probably less"); the abstract does not, and the word "own" is precisely the isolation the control cannot deliver. Recomputed: log(3.18)/log(6.6) = 61% objective, log(2.08)/log(6.6) = 39% residual — not halves, and the 39% is an upper bound for the representation, not its value.
